headline: US Treasury Delays Citgo Share Seizure Deadline to December 2026
summary: The US Treasury has extended the deadline for bondholders to claim Citgo shares until December 18, 2026. The department signaled it would support a restructuring agreement for the company.
why: Citgo is a major US-based refiner owned by the Venezuelan state oil company PDVSA, currently subject to complex legal claims from creditors seeking to recover debts from the Venezuelan government.

impacts.name: Citgo
impacts.why: The extension provides more time for a potential restructuring, delaying immediate liquidation risks.
